answer.reason: Based on QCEW data for California in 2024 Q4, the private-sector covered employment in NAICS 54 Professional, scientific, and technical services was approximately 1.4 million jobs. The option matching that level is 1,405,205 covered jobs.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for California, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 54 Professional, scientific, and technical services?

A. 1,405,205 covered jobs
B. 897,501 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, California statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/06000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: B
